notes.title: Minor Bug Fix and Subreddit Creation
notes.notes:
This update fixes the bug that prevents users from leaving the Settings Menu when in-game. 

I've also created a new subreddit to discuss the game here:
https://www.reddit.com/r/symplgames

Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: A small sanity update
notes.notes:
I've addressed some of the issues I've gotten, but please continue to let me know more about what you'd like to see in the game. You can find some of the changes below. 
----------------------------NOTES----------------------------
- Fixed resolution settings.
- Added audio settings.
- Fixed item tooltips.
- Updated Fog in Campaign to improve lighting.
- Fixed an issue that let the player can jump glitch through rocks to skp to the end area.
- Fixed mage attunement
- Fixed an issue that let player see friendly NPC stat bars.
- Added special effects for crit hits.
- Fixed issue that prevented player from leaving the in game menu.
----------------------------NOTES----------------------------
----------------------------BUGS----------------------------
- Wierd particle system shows up in Campaign.
----------------------------BUGS----------------------------
